guitar.evidence: Kevin "Noodles" Wasserman is well documented for playing Ibanez guitars, including his own Ibanez signature model.

tone.target: bright punk crunch with tight palm-mute attack
tone.profile: bright punk crunch with tight palm-mute attack
tone.summary: A high-gain, mid-focused chain utilizing a Boost/OD for attack, followed by an AC30 TB or UK 45 model to deliver the required bright, crunchy rhythm tone, paired with minimal ambience.

rig.name: The Offspring - Come Out And Play - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in fast punk rhythm playing.
Provide the necessary tight attack and slight grit for palm-muted punk rhythm.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to provide a slightly more aggressive, mid-focused crunch suitable for pop-punk without sounding too dirty.

blocks.purpose: Used as a secondary boost/grit layer if the Green OD is insufficient, but kept inactive to maintain clarity and punch.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is generally too aggressive for this specific tone. It remains available for minor adjustments or alternative grit sources.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, mid-focused British tone (Marshall style) required for punk crunch.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary punchy low-mids.
Tuck the low end slightly to maintain tightness and boost upper mids for clarity and bite.
Not required for this rhythm tone; kept inactive.
Avoid modulation effects as per the 'avoid' list.
Keep the tone dry and punchy; delay is unnecessary.
Provide minimal, natural ambience without sounding heavy or muddy.
blocks.gap: The 'avoid' list suggests avoiding heavy reverb; a low-mix Room setting is used for subtle depth only.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more aggressively bright, punk-specific 4x12.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Punk/Pop Punk 4x12 IR (e.g., Fender Twin or Celestion Greenback style)
proposals.reason: The current IR is too general; a brighter, tighter punk-specific cab will enhance the required bite and punch.
